name: 0DTE Naked Short Call
summary: Sell a same-day uncovered call for a few cents of premium against unlimited intraday risk. Level 4, blocked, and the worst risk-per-dollar structure available.
max_loss: UNDEFINED. A single intraday melt-up can produce a loss 20-50x the credit before the bell, with no time to recover.

greeks.delta: -0.05 to -0.15 at entry, can reach -0.95 within an hour
greeks.gamma: the most negative gamma available anywhere

when_to_use: Never. Documented so the automation refuses it and so backtests can quantify exactly how bad the tail is.
entry_rules: BLOCKED: Level 4 required; Alpaca offers levels 1-3 only and this account is Level 3
Even if permitted, an unhedged 0DTE short call violates the system's core mandate of defined risk
exit_rules: Any detected uncovered 0DTE short call is bought to close at market immediately
An ITM 0DTE short call left at the bell is assigned that evening, creating a short 100-share position that settles against an account with no borrow arrangement
assignment_risk: EXTREME with same-day finality. There is no roll, no repair and no time.
buying_power: Naked call margin; unavailable at Level 3.
common_mistakes: Thinking a 5-delta 0DTE call is a 95% win rate. The 5% costs more than the 95% earns without a long wing.
blocked_because: needs Alpaca options level 4; this account is level 3. Alpaca rejects it with 'account not eligible to trade uncovered option contracts'. Raising the level is an Alpaca approval, not a code change.
